games.name: Knee Slice Progression Game
games.topPlayer: Start in combat base, must touch inside thigh 3 times before attempting knee slice pass
games.bottomPlayer: Retain guard using frames and distance management
games.coaching: Top: Pressure through frames. Bottom: Active hips and grips

games.name: Toreando Touch Game
games.topPlayer: Must touch both knees alternating 5 times before toreando pass
games.bottomPlayer: Keep feet between you and passer

games.name: Over-Under Pass Timer
games.topPlayer: Establish over-under grip, pass within 30 seconds or reset
games.bottomPlayer: Prevent hip control and create angles

games.name: Leg Drag Checkpoint
games.topPlayer: Must secure leg drag grip, touch hip, then complete pass
games.bottomPlayer: Recover guard before hip control established

games.name: Stack Pass Resistance
games.topPlayer: Stack opponent's hips and pass, bottom gets 2 points if they prevent stack
games.bottomPlayer: Post on mat and granby to prevent stack

games.name: X-Pass Flow Game
games.topPlayer: Switch between toreando and knee slice every 10 seconds
games.bottomPlayer: Adapt guard retention to passing style
games.coaching: Read and react to pressure changes

games.name: Long Step Pass Rush
games.topPlayer: Long step around guard, must keep both feet on mat
games.bottomPlayer: Hip escape to recover guard or get to knees

games.name: Pressure Pass Battle
games.topPlayer: Heavy pressure through guard, can only advance by maintaining chest pressure
games.bottomPlayer: Create frames and angles to escape pressure

games.name: Float Pass Sequence
games.topPlayer: Float pass attempt, if blocked switch to back step
games.bottomPlayer: Control distance and block hip movement

games.name: Smash Pass Points
games.topPlayer: Smash pass from half guard, 2 points for mount finish
games.bottomPlayer: Prevent crossface and recover full guard
games.coaching: Control the head and shoulder line

games.name: Headquarters Position Game
games.topPlayer: Establish headquarters, score by maintaining position 10 seconds
games.bottomPlayer: Recover full guard or get to knees

games.name: Ankle Pick Pass
games.topPlayer: Pick ankle while passing, opponent can't use that leg for 5 seconds
games.bottomPlayer: Hop to maintain guard or recover

games.name: Backstep Challenge
games.topPlayer: Must backstep over leg, score by taking back or passing

games.name: Double Under Escape
games.topPlayer: Double under pass, maintain grip throughout
games.bottomPlayer: Break grips or create space to escape

games.name: Compass Pass Game
games.topPlayer: Can only advance by passing in cardinal directions: N, S, E, W
games.bottomPlayer: Track direction changes and maintain guard

games.name: Frame Survival Game
games.topPlayer: Remove all frames within 20 seconds to pass
games.bottomPlayer: Maintain at least one frame on opponent

games.name: Hip Escape Chain
games.bottomPlayer: Chain 3 hip escapes before recovering full guard

games.name: Grip Strip Battle
games.bottomPlayer: Strip grips within 10 seconds or give up position

games.name: Distance Management
games.bottomPlayer: Use feet to maintain 2-foot distance for 20 seconds

games.name: Shin Shield Hold
games.bottomPlayer: Maintain shin shield contact for 15 seconds

games.name: Inversion Recovery
games.bottomPlayer: Use inversion to recover guard 3 times

games.name: Butterfly Hook Game
games.topPlayer: Remove both butterfly hooks to pass
games.bottomPlayer: Maintain at least one hook at all times

games.name: Collar Sleeve Sweep or Retain
games.bottomPlayer: Sweep or retain guard, can't let pass happen

games.name: Granby Roll Escape
games.bottomPlayer: Use granby rolls to recover guard from bad positions

games.name: K-Guard Retention
games.bottomPlayer: Maintain reverse DLR hook and off-balance opponent

games.name: Open Guard Circuit
games.bottomPlayer: Switch between 3 different open guards every 15 seconds

games.name: Seated Guard Retention
games.bottomPlayer: Maintain seated position and active feet

games.name: Underhook Battle
games.bottomPlayer: Fight for underhook and come to knees

games.name: Lockdown Control
games.bottomPlayer: Establish lockdown and sweep or take back

games.name: Old School Sweep Setup
games.bottomPlayer: Set up old school sweep or come to knees

games.name: Deep Half Recovery

games.bottomPlayer: Get to deep half guard position

games.name: Z-Guard Sweep Game

games.name: Crossface Escape

games.name: Homer Simpson Sweep

games.name: North-South Submission Hunt

games.name: Gift Wrap Control

games.name: Transitional Control
